svg.aria-label: A WeatherLinkIP console steered from whole-second readings
svg.title: A WeatherLinkIP console steered from whole-second readings
svg.desc: Ten simulated days of a console behind a WeatherLinkIP, kept by the driver. For the first two days it learns from its whole-second readings, the dots, and writes nothing. Then each evening it decides from the line through them, and rewrites the midnight jump when the clock would leave the band around center: 3 writes, and the clock is never set.
svg.text: Console clock error behind a WeatherLinkIP, seconds (positive is fast)
line: the clock; dots: the whole-second readings kept; shaded: the band, give or take 0.35 s; labels: jumps written
